summary: Short, very steep school-street kerb with a pedestrian crossing and stopping signs.

drivers.seclusion: No dwellings within 36 m, but the school and pool front the kerb and it is busy by day.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with kerb-to-fence on the west; a pedestrian crossing sits at the south end.
drivers.traffic: School street with drop-off traffic on schooldays.
drivers.convention: 1/4P Parallel schooldays 8am-4pm plus No Stopping Any Time; no sign of overnight parking.

flags: No Stopping Any Time and 1/4P school-day signs
Mapped car park 13 m away may be a better option
sun_shade: Tall trees and school buildings shade the kerb from the west.
